responsibility: Provides the MinGW/Win32 target configuration variant for linking against CRTDLL.DLL instead of the more common MSVCRT-based runtime. It specializes the i386 Windows target specs by defining the preprocessor builtins that identify the CRTDLL environment, the libgcc and C runtime link sequence, and the startup-file selection for executables versus DLLs, making it a narrow OS/runtime-selection header within the PE/COFF configuration family.
